title: I built a SaaS in 48 hours using only AI — here's what happened

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: If AI can build a SaaS in 48 hours, what does that mean for the future of work and innovation?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Tools like Copilot, AutoML, and no-code platforms let builders prototype apps fast with minimal code.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Rapid AI development risks job displacement and creates tools that amplify bias or misinformation.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are prioritizing audits, transparency, and user feedback to ensure ethical deployment.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where AI aids human creativity, not replaces it, could unlock unprecedented collaboration.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t just about speed — it’s about shaping AI’s role in society with intention and care.

video_cue: A montage of AI-generated code being written, reviewed, and deployed into a functional SaaS application.
